candidates.statement: Order service shows sustained heap retention: retained_bytes rises 49.2MB to 81.2MB across 5 samples with positive net allocations and no reclaim after GC, plus 9 retained_heap_after_gc WARN logs. This is the only service with anomalous memory behavior; gateway, inventory and payment are healthy.
candidates.uncertainty: Deployment of order 3.0.6 is recorded but the deployment record alone does not establish causation; latency impact not yet observed.

Bounded candidate: memory-leak in order. Deployment record is noted but not treated as causal.
